reviews.comment: Git agent missing WHEN TO NOTIFY — merge notification never fires. Fix: add section to SKILL_GIT constant in init/index.ts and to .claude/commands/task-git.md.

Round 2: (1) All SKILL_* constants in init/index.ts missing WHEN TO NOTIFY — consumer projects get no notifications. (2) task-git skill missing directly. (3) Section placement too weak — agents skip it; must embed in workflow steps.

Round 3: Design direction — create shared AGENT_NOTIFY.md (same pattern as AGENT_ENFORCEMENT.md / AGENT_PROTOCOL.md), replace all inline WHEN TO NOTIFY blocks with @AGENT_NOTIFY.md reference. Cleaner, single source of truth, easier stripping when notifications.cli=false.

fix.comment: Round 3 fix: AGENT_NOTIFY.md shared file — replaced per-file WHEN TO NOTIFY with @AGENT_NOTIFY.md reference; added notify steps to SKILL_* constants; simplified stripWhenToNotify to blank AGENT_NOTIFY.md

reviews.comment: Round 4: browser notification title missing projectName prefix (spec requires '<projectName>: <taskId> → <status>', implementation uses '<taskId> → <status>'); buildConfigWithExamples emits duplicate notifications key
Design direction: notification should fire via a hook when agent finishes work (like PostToolUse activity hook), not via explicit insight-flow notify calls in agent prompts

fix.comment: Added Stop hook for automatic notify; fixed projectName in browser notif title; fixed duplicate notifications key in init --examples

reviews.comment: Post-restart test confirmed: Stop hook fires OS notifications automatically
Notifications never fire on global v0.4.0 install — notify command not in that version
